<div class="pvme-exact-guide">
<h1 id="temple-of-aminishi-basic" class="pvme-source-title"><nowiki>Temple of Aminishi Basic</nowiki></h1>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><pvme-image src="https://img.pvme.io/images/LdYq2RP.png" alt="" title="" kind="media" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>ED1 is a very consistent money-maker and a good avenue for players to practice using AoE abilities, movement, avoiding damaging mechanics and DPS rotations. The requirements to feasibly solo it are moderate and many deaths should be expected when learning the dungeon due to the nature of the mechanics.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Use the zerker aura </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/643505116347105290.png?v=1" alt="berserker" title="berserker" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/643505179378974748.png?v=1" alt="reckless" title="reckless" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/643505153709965322.png?v=1" alt="mani" title="mani" kind="icon" /><nowiki> variants for the dungeon. Otherwise, </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/643505653079343144.png?v=1" alt="vamp" title="vamp" kind="icon" /><nowiki> is fine for learning, but prioritise using defence reducing abilities for special attacks (</nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513203008608141314.png?v=1" alt="gstaff" title="gstaff" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1" alt="eofspec" title="eofspec" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879506309150.png?v=1" alt="quake" title="quake" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641670143197446182.png?v=1" alt="swh" title="swh" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1" alt="eofspec" title="eofspec" kind="icon" /><nowiki>) on Masuta and Seiryu's face. Also, expect to do additional cycles on Seiryu.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="the-sanctum-guardian-info"><nowiki>The Sanctum Guardian (Info)</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><pvme-image src="https://img.pvme.io/images/KCgIv13UAG.png" alt="" title="" kind="media" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>The first boss you encounter. Sanctum uses primarily slow </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1" alt="range" title="range" kind="icon" /><nowiki> auto attacks which hit moderately hard. However, they are aimed at the players' tile instead of character so you are able to dodge them by stepping away 3 or more tiles before they hit.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>

</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div style="background-color: rgb(0, 153, 255)"></div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>

</nowiki><div><u><nowiki>Mechanics</nowiki></u><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><nowiki>

</nowiki><div><div><div><u><nowiki>Attack Rotation</nowiki></u><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><div class="pvme-source-preserve-lines"><nowiki>⬥ Sanctum's attack pattern is:
    • Start of fight: 4x Ranged autoattack to start the fight.
    • Rest of fight: Water Burst → Ranged auto → Water Jet → Ranged auto → Purple Smoke → Melee auto → repeat
    • After the 4th water jet attack, 2 Crassian Reinforcements are summoned.
    • The melee auto does nothing if you are out of melee range.
​
</nowiki></div></div><div><div><u><nowiki>Ranged Autoattacks</nowiki></u><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><div class="pvme-source-preserve-lines"><nowiki>⬥ A projectile that targets the spot the player is standing on and hits in a 3x3 area. </nowiki>[https://img.pvme.io/images/r63xxBI.mp4 <nowiki>Example</nowiki>]<nowiki>
    • Targeted to a tile rather than the player and has travel time before it hits
    • It is possible to dodge every Ranged autoattack simply by moving before the attack lands (not necessary).
​
</nowiki></div></div><div><div><u><nowiki>Water Burst</nowiki></u><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><div class="pvme-source-preserve-lines"><nowiki>⬥ Sanctum ducks down and rises back up quickly, splashing water and dealing heavy </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1" alt="melee" title="melee" kind="icon" /><nowiki> damage. </nowiki>[https://img.pvme.io/images/TJngvfo.mp4 <nowiki>Example</nowiki>]<nowiki>
⬥ Use </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/544195488447201300.png?v=1" alt="DeflectMelee" title="DeflectMelee" kind="icon" /><nowiki> as soon as you see this mechanic as it is very fast. You can also </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258844635148.png?v=1" alt="res" title="res" kind="icon" /><nowiki> this if needed.
    • Staying or moving out of range in time will cause the attack to miss. Doing this is usually unnecessary. </nowiki>[https://youtu.be/3xDLQIAMeEc <nowiki>Example</nowiki>]<nowiki>
​
</nowiki></div></div><div><div><u><nowiki>Water Jet</nowiki></u><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><div class="pvme-source-preserve-lines"><nowiki>⬥ Sanctum spews water, rotating from North anti-clockwise, dealing ~6000 soft typeless damage if the player is caught in it. </nowiki>[https://img.pvme.io/images/xbJwXJj.mp4 <nowiki>Example</nowiki>]<nowiki>
    • This mechanic can be avoided by moving to dodge it or via </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258844635148.png?v=1" alt="res" title="res" kind="icon" /><nowiki> or </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535614336207552523.png?v=1" alt="disrupt" title="disrupt" kind="icon" /><nowiki>.
    • You can also </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541278264393729.png?v=1" alt="debil" title="debil" kind="icon" /><nowiki> or </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258786177064.png?v=1" alt="reflect" title="reflect" kind="icon" /><nowiki> to reduce the damage if need be, although these are less efficient.
​
</nowiki></div></div><div><div><u><nowiki>Purple Smoke</nowiki></u><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><div class="pvme-source-preserve-lines"><nowiki>⬥ A blue bar appears above your character. When it drains, a cloud of smoke will cover a 5x5 area centred around your location. </nowiki>[https://img.pvme.io/images/CCIKuCR.mp4 <nowiki>Example</nowiki>]<nowiki>
    • The smoke deals rapid typeless damage every tick which increases very fast, hitting ~4000 a tick eventually. Move out of it as soon as possible.
    • Move to the place you want to drop it walk out after it drops. Don't panic and walk around unnecessarily, causing you to drop it in an undesirable position.
​
</nowiki></div></div></div><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><nowiki>

</nowiki></div><nowiki>


</nowiki></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div>
<nowiki>

</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="the-sanctum-guardian-fight-tips"><nowiki>The Sanctum Guardian (Fight tips)</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ You may die a few times because the mechanics are quite fast and arguably hard to react to. This is perfectly normal.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Outline of rotations:</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail pvme-source-sequence"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1" alt="melee" title="melee" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854004678657.png?v=1" alt="zerk" title="zerk" kind="icon" /><nowiki> + </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/736298121704767538.png?v=1" alt="adrenrenewal" title="adrenrenewal" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532855191928842.png?v=1" alt="assault" title="assault" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879330148352.png?v=1" alt="destroy" title="destroy" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879283879977.png?v=1" alt="gflurry" title="gflurry" kind="icon" /><nowiki> (if owned) → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/959089455640215633.png?v=1" alt="overpowerigneous" title="overpowerigneous" kind="icon" /><nowiki> after </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854004678657.png?v=1" alt="zerk" title="zerk" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → cycle thresholds again → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854004678657.png?v=1" alt="zerk" title="zerk" kind="icon" /><nowiki> again ASAP and finish off</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail pvme-source-sequence"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1" alt="range" title="range" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921597813137518.png?v=1" alt="deathsswiftpf" title="deathsswiftpf" kind="icon" /><nowiki> + </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/736298121704767538.png?v=1" alt="adrenrenewal" title="adrenrenewal" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535534127131394088.png?v=1" alt="snap" title="snap" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541270521708566.png?v=1" alt="rapid" title="rapid" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/642713547142332416.png?v=1" alt="shadowtend" title="shadowtend" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535534127131394088.png?v=1" alt="snap" title="snap" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541270521708566.png?v=1" alt="rapid" title="rapid" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/959089455283728386.png?v=1" alt="deadshotigneous" title="deadshotigneous" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → good thresholds → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921597813137518.png?v=1" alt="deathsswiftpf" title="deathsswiftpf" kind="icon" /><nowiki> again ASAP → finish off with </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/959089455283728386.png?v=1" alt="deadshotigneous" title="deadshotigneous" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and good thresholds</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail pvme-source-sequence"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1" alt="Magic" title="Magic" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921595489488927.png?v=1" alt="sunshinepf" title="sunshinepf" kind="icon" /><nowiki> + </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/736298121704767538.png?v=1" alt="adrenrenewal" title="adrenrenewal" kind="icon" /><nowiki> + </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/856635090641879050.png?v=1" alt="smokecloud" title="smokecloud" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533809978966037.png?v=1" alt="wm" title="wm" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833072672778.png?v=1" alt="asphyx" title="asphyx" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533809664262179.png?v=1" alt="omni" title="omni" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533809978966037.png?v=1" alt="wm" title="wm" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833072672778.png?v=1" alt="asphyx" title="asphyx" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533809995874304.png?v=1" alt="tsunami" title="tsunami" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → thresholds → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1179505745654448208.png?v=1" alt="omnipowerigneous" title="omnipowerigneous" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921595489488927.png?v=1" alt="sunshinepf" title="sunshinepf" kind="icon" /><nowiki> again ASAP</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Use </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854004678657.png?v=1" alt="zerk" title="zerk" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921597813137518.png?v=1" alt="deathsswiftpf" title="deathsswiftpf" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921595489488927.png?v=1" alt="sunshinepf" title="sunshinepf" kind="icon" /><nowiki> again on the other side if boss has &gt;100k HP left.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ If using </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1" alt="range" title="range" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, you may find it useful to side step attacks from time to time as you have the most mobility while using abilities.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<pvme-video src="https://img.pvme.io/images/j5yD1xR.mp4" controls="1" loop="1" muted="1" type="video/mp4" />
<nowiki>

</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ An easy way to dodge Water Jet if fighting Sanctum from the front is standing east then walking west as follows:</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<pvme-video src="https://img.pvme.io/images/OSdmLyz.mp4" controls="1" loop="1" muted="1" type="video/mp4" />
<nowiki>

</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ If you don't wish to teleport out to bank before Sanctum, go to the back and fight while standing along this thing so that Anagamis and Arhats following you get stuck as shown below and do not bother you during the fight.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><pvme-image src="https://img.pvme.io/images/7qIjbzv.png" alt="" title="" kind="media" /><nowiki>
​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="masuta-the-ascended-info"><ins><nowiki>Masuta, the Ascended (Info)</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><pvme-image src="https://img.pvme.io/images/l1tE0lAhOH.png" alt="" title="" kind="media" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>Masuta is the second boss of ED1. Expect to eat a lot of food during this fight. Masuta is a fairly hard fight, dealing both high burst and sustained damage on the player. He is considered by some to be the hardest in the dungeon.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>

</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div style="background-color: rgb(0, 153, 255)"></div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>

</nowiki><div><u><nowiki>Mechanics</nowiki></u><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><nowiki>

</nowiki><div><div><div><u><nowiki>P1 Rotation</nowiki></u><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><div class="pvme-source-preserve-lines"><nowiki>⬥ Masuta attacks at the fight using the following rotation:
    • 2-4 autos → Hurricane → 3-5 autos → Tsunami → 3-5 autos → Repeats from Hurricane.
​
</nowiki></div></div><div><div><u><nowiki>Autoattack information</nowiki></u><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><div class="pvme-source-preserve-lines"><nowiki>⬥ Masuta mostly uses </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1" alt="melee" title="melee" kind="icon" /><nowiki> during p1, occasionally using </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1" alt="range" title="range" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki>[https://img.pvme.io/images/lQiGv8Y.mp4 <nowiki>Example</nowiki>]<nowiki>
    • Occasionally, he summons a clone while using </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1" alt="melee" title="melee" kind="icon" /><nowiki> which deals an additional hit. </nowiki>[https://img.pvme.io/images/VrBObJ5.mp4 <nowiki>Example</nowiki>]<nowiki>
        ⬩ It is important to block these doubled autos with </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/544195488447201300.png?v=1" alt="DeflectMelee" title="DeflectMelee" kind="icon" /><nowiki>
​
</nowiki></div></div><div><div><u><nowiki>Hurricane</nowiki></u><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><div class="pvme-source-preserve-lines"><nowiki>⬥ Masuta starts spinning for about 12 seconds, hitting nearby players for increasing Melee damage once per tick, chasing after you at walking speed during this attack.
    • The best way to deal with this is </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/544195488447201300.png?v=1" alt="DeflectMelee" title="DeflectMelee" kind="icon" /><nowiki> + </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158728953857.png?v=1" alt="devo" title="devo" kind="icon" /><nowiki> 1 GCD after the attack starts, allowing you to deal damage in MD and nullifies most of the damage you take.
    • If using ranged, you may kite Masuta and use </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921597813137518.png?v=1" alt="deathsswiftpf" title="deathsswiftpf" kind="icon" /><nowiki> once he finishes spinning.
    • It's possible to </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/841419289755385866.png?v=1" alt="flankicon" title="flankicon" kind="icon" /><nowiki> Masuta from the north side during this attack.
​
</nowiki></div></div><div><div><u><nowiki>Tsunami</nowiki></u><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><div class="pvme-source-preserve-lines"><nowiki>⬥ After Hurricane, Masuta returns to autoing, usually around the 4th, 5th or 6th autoattack, purple waters appear around the arena. The purples water thrash about while Masuta uses 3 more autos. Right after the 3rd auto, Masuta uses a Tsunami on his target. </nowiki>[https://img.pvme.io/images/zHMArnZ.mp4 <nowiki>Example</nowiki>]<nowiki>
    • These hit you with two extremely high (7k+) </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1" alt="Magic" title="Magic" kind="icon" /><nowiki> hits.
        ⬩ This can be dealt with by using both </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535614336207552523.png?v=1" alt="disrupt" title="disrupt" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258844635148.png?v=1" alt="res" title="res" kind="icon" /><nowiki> after Masuta's 3rd autoattack. </nowiki>[https://youtu.be/WZlGkkmUsis <nowiki>Example</nowiki>]<nowiki>
        ⬩ You can also move far enough to avoid getting hit. This can be done by either running or using </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1" alt="surge" title="surge" kind="icon" /><nowiki> as the auto before the </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533809995874304.png?v=1" alt="tsunami" title="tsunami" kind="icon" /><nowiki> hits. </nowiki>[https://youtu.be/qrcCqidKhe0 <nowiki>Example</nowiki>]<nowiki>
​
</nowiki></div></div><div><div><u><nowiki>Pulverise</nowiki></u><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><div class="pvme-source-preserve-lines"><nowiki>⬥ After Tsunami, for the rest of Phase 1 Masuta may use Pulverise instead of an auto, dealing moderate </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1" alt="melee" title="melee" kind="icon" /><nowiki> damage. </nowiki>[https://img.pvme.io/images/LvR5mBE.mp4 <nowiki>Example</nowiki>]<nowiki>
    • You can use </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/544195488447201300.png?v=1" alt="DeflectMelee" title="DeflectMelee" kind="icon" /><nowiki> or run 2 tiles away to avoid this.
        ⬩ You only have 1 tick to move far enough when the text 'I'll pulverise you!' appears.
​
</nowiki></div></div><div><div><u><nowiki>Waters</nowiki></u><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><div class="pvme-source-preserve-lines"><nowiki>⬥ Once his HP reaches 275k, Masuta will stop attacking, start levitating, reducing all damage to 1. </nowiki>[https://img.pvme.io/images/Fe0ihJk.mp4 <nowiki>Example</nowiki>]<nowiki>
    • Thrashing waters will start spawning randomly periodically. They have 8000 HP and a very long-ranged </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1" alt="Magic" title="Magic" kind="icon" /><nowiki> autoattack.
    • Up to 15 Thrashing Waters will be spawned over 90s.
    • Pray Deflect Magic </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/544195487926845462.png?v=1" alt="DeflectMage" title="DeflectMage" kind="icon" /><nowiki>
    • When a water is killed, players within a 2 tiles receive a 5% Calm Waters buff. </nowiki>[https://img.pvme.io/images/gvMdd2v.mp4 <nowiki>Example</nowiki>]<nowiki>
        ⬩ This reduces the damage from Tsunamis in next phase relative to the percentage of the buff.
    • Use </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641337999170207763.png?v=1" alt="excal" title="excal" kind="icon" /><nowiki> to sustain HP during this phase and </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158728953857.png?v=1" alt="devo" title="devo" kind="icon" /><nowiki> whenever it comes up to reduce damage taken.
​
</nowiki></div></div><div><div><u><nowiki>Last phase</nowiki></u><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><div class="pvme-source-preserve-lines"><nowiki>⬥ Masuta yells 'These waters will choke you where you stand!' and returns to the floor from his levitation. </nowiki>[https://img.pvme.io/images/W6v0V4g.mp4 <nowiki>Example</nowiki>]<nowiki>
    • After he resumes attacking, he always does 2 </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1" alt="range" title="range" kind="icon" /><nowiki> autos followed by a Tsunami.
    • For the rest of the phase, Masuta will cycle between using 3-6 </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1" alt="range" title="range" kind="icon" /><nowiki> autos and then a powerful </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1" alt="Magic" title="Magic" kind="icon" /><nowiki> Tsunami attack.
    • Standing far away can help with prayer flicking as both autos and Tsunami will hit later.
    • The magic attack has a travel time based on distance. While in MD the attack hits you instantly, while Ranged autoattacks take 1 tick to hit you.
    • As Masuta has an attack speed of 4 ticks, by rotating your overhead prayers </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/615613924506599497.png?v=1" alt="soulsplit" title="soulsplit" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/544195487926845462.png?v=1" alt="DeflectMage" title="DeflectMage" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/615613924506599497.png?v=1" alt="soulsplit" title="soulsplit" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/544195488317046812.png?v=1" alt="DeflectRange" title="DeflectRange" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → repeat, you will always be praying correctly.
​
</nowiki></div></div></div><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><nowiki>

</nowiki></div><nowiki>


</nowiki></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div>
<nowiki>

</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="masuta-the-ascended-fight-tips"><nowiki>Masuta, the Ascended (Fight tips)</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ You may want to bank or use a preset with more food for this encounter.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ If you receive a second Hurricane special (where </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158728953857.png?v=1" alt="devo" title="devo" kind="icon" /><nowiki> is down), try to stay as far away from Masuta as possible. Use </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541278264393729.png?v=1" alt="debil" title="debil" kind="icon" /><nowiki> or </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258786177064.png?v=1" alt="reflect" title="reflect" kind="icon" /><nowiki> if needed.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Using channelled abilities such as </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833072672778.png?v=1" alt="asphyx" title="asphyx" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879330148352.png?v=1" alt="destroy" title="destroy" kind="icon" /><nowiki> or </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258425204770.png?v=1" alt="snipe" title="snipe" kind="icon" /><nowiki> will help you avoid getting walked while Masuta spins.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• This does not work on channelled special attacks such as </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/881962727705280512.png?v=1" alt="armadylbattlestaff" title="armadylbattlestaff" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1" alt="eofspec" title="eofspec" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and you will get walked</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Rotation outlines:</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• These rotations are to be used at the start and then repeated after waters to finish Masuta off.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158728953857.png?v=1" alt="devo" title="devo" kind="icon" /><nowiki> will need to be used some time after the first threshold, unless you are kiting</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641339233638023179.png?v=1" alt="limitless" title="limitless" kind="icon" /><nowiki> if needed.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail pvme-source-sequence"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1" alt="melee" title="melee" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854004678657.png?v=1" alt="zerk" title="zerk" kind="icon" /><nowiki> + </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/736298121704767538.png?v=1" alt="adrenrenewal" title="adrenrenewal" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532855191928842.png?v=1" alt="assault" title="assault" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879330148352.png?v=1" alt="destroy" title="destroy" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879283879977.png?v=1" alt="gflurry" title="gflurry" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/959089455640215633.png?v=1" alt="overpowerigneous" title="overpowerigneous" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → bleeds → thresholds → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/959089455640215633.png?v=1" alt="overpowerigneous" title="overpowerigneous" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail pvme-source-sequence"><nowiki>‎‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1" alt="range" title="range" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/959089455283728386.png?v=1" alt="deadshotigneous" title="deadshotigneous" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → bleeds → thresholds → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921597813137518.png?v=1" alt="deathsswiftpf" title="deathsswiftpf" kind="icon" /><nowiki> + </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/736298121704767538.png?v=1" alt="adrenrenewal" title="adrenrenewal" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535534127131394088.png?v=1" alt="snap" title="snap" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541270521708566.png?v=1" alt="rapid" title="rapid" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/642713547142332416.png?v=1" alt="shadowtend" title="shadowtend" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535534127131394088.png?v=1" alt="snap" title="snap" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541270521708566.png?v=1" alt="rapid" title="rapid" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/959089455283728386.png?v=1" alt="deadshotigneous" title="deadshotigneous" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail pvme-source-sequence"><nowiki>‎‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1" alt="Magic" title="Magic" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921595489488927.png?v=1" alt="sunshinepf" title="sunshinepf" kind="icon" /><nowiki> + </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/736298121704767538.png?v=1" alt="adrenrenewal" title="adrenrenewal" kind="icon" /><nowiki> + </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/856635090641879050.png?v=1" alt="smokecloud" title="smokecloud" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/958989794757730307.png?v=1" alt="tsunamiincite" title="tsunamiincite" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533809978966037.png?v=1" alt="wm" title="wm" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833072672778.png?v=1" alt="asphyx" title="asphyx" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1179505745654448208.png?v=1" alt="omnipowerigneous" title="omnipowerigneous" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533809978966037.png?v=1" alt="wm" title="wm" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833072672778.png?v=1" alt="asphyx" title="asphyx" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Using </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513201065907322880.png?v=1" alt="Sacrifice" title="Sacrifice" kind="icon" /><nowiki> to finish off waters and </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306475151390.png?v=1" alt="anti" title="anti" kind="icon" /><nowiki> between spawns help with reducing food usage.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• You can also </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258844635148.png?v=1" alt="res" title="res" kind="icon" /><nowiki> an occasional waters auto if needed.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ When Masuta resumes attacking after waters, make sure you are high HP as he will do 2 </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1" alt="range" title="range" kind="icon" /><nowiki> autos while you are probably still finish off the remaining waters, which deal </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1" alt="Magic" title="Magic" kind="icon" /><nowiki> damage. This damage can stack you out if not careful.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="seiryu-the-azure-serpent-info"><ins><nowiki>Seiryu, the Azure Serpent (Info)</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><pvme-image src="https://img.pvme.io/images/dksAPM9sP5.png" alt="" title="" kind="media" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>Seiryu is the final boss of ED1 and attacks using primarily </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1" alt="Magic" title="Magic" kind="icon" /><nowiki> auto attacks.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>

</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div style="background-color: rgb(0, 153, 255)"></div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>

</nowiki><div><u><nowiki>Mechanics</nowiki></u><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><nowiki>

</nowiki><div><div><div><u><nowiki>Face (7500k-7200k HP)</nowiki></u><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><div class="pvme-source-preserve-lines"><nowiki>⬥ Seiryu first does 4 attacks then continues with the following attack rotation
    • Huge Breath → 2 attacks → Shadow Energy → 2 attacks → repeat
    • Seiryu's standard attack is either a slow </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1" alt="Magic" title="Magic" kind="icon" /><nowiki> attack (easy to flick) or a tail blackhole.
    • The 2nd Shadow Energy mechanic will be replaced by the Black Hands mechanic.
​
</nowiki></div></div><div><div><u><nowiki>Tail Blackhole</nowiki></u><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><div class="pvme-source-preserve-lines"><nowiki>⬥ Seiryu dips his tail into the floor to summon a black hole under the player. </nowiki>[https://img.pvme.io/images/zwFuDq4.mp4 <nowiki>Example</nowiki>]<nowiki>
    • Summoned blackholes will cover a 2x2 area, dealing rapid and increasing damage (~2000 per tick) to players standing on them, lasting for about 10 seconds before disappearing.
    • Move out (1 tile north/east or 2 tiles south/west) of it to avoid damage.
​
</nowiki></div></div><div><div><u><nowiki>Huge Breath</nowiki></u><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><div class="pvme-source-preserve-lines"><nowiki>⬥ The message 'Seiryu takes a huge breath!' appears and Seiryu will swing his head from east to west while doing a breath attack. </nowiki>[https://img.pvme.io/images/fsznjRq.mp4 <nowiki>Example</nowiki>]<nowiki>
    • This deals ~8000 </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1" alt="Magic" title="Magic" kind="icon" /><nowiki> attack unprotected.
    • You can dodge this attack by standing along the 2 southern rows of the arena. Alternatively, use </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535614336207552523.png?v=1" alt="disrupt" title="disrupt" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/544195487926845462.png?v=1" alt="DeflectMage" title="DeflectMage" kind="icon" /><nowiki> or </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258844635148.png?v=1" alt="res" title="res" kind="icon" /><nowiki>.
    • The hit lands when Seiryu's head reaches west making it easy to react to.
​
</nowiki></div></div><div><div><u><nowiki>Shadow Energy</nowiki></u><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><div class="pvme-source-preserve-lines"><nowiki>⬥ The game message 'Shadow energy bursts forth from Seiryu.' appears, and Seiryu launches a shadow projectile towards a tile marked by an arrow. Shortly after, highly damaging black hands will move from the marked tile towards your current location. </nowiki>[https://img.pvme.io/images/0NPw0Ot.mp4 <nowiki>Example</nowiki>]<nowiki>
    • Move out of the way when the black hands spawn.
    • The hands have moderate KO potential so be careful especially if the projectile lands near you.
​
</nowiki></div></div><div><div><u><nowiki>Black Hands</nowiki></u><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><div class="pvme-source-preserve-lines"><nowiki>⬥ Replaces Seiryu's 2nd Shadow Energy mechanic. Black hands spawn from a random point along the south wall and move north, expanding out in V-shape pattern. </nowiki>[https://img.pvme.io/images/4YRp1Ra.mp4 <nowiki>Example</nowiki>]<nowiki>
    • These hands are extremely damaging, avoiding them is vital.
    • Take extremely caution especially if using </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1" alt="melee" title="melee" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and don't stand directly at the south wall when this mechanic is imminent.
    • Once this mechanic has been cast, a new set of black hands will spawn when the current formation is complete.
​
</nowiki></div></div><div><div><u><nowiki>Shackle</nowiki></u><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><div class="pvme-source-preserve-lines"><nowiki>⬥ At 7200k HP, Seiryu stops his attacks and lowers his head, all existing mechanics then disappear. </nowiki>[https://img.pvme.io/images/6UThIKD.mp4 <nowiki>Example</nowiki>]<nowiki>
    • You will be able to climb the shackle at these two points and start damaging the Black Crystals on the shackle. </nowiki>[https://img.pvme.io/images/ia7OVYS.png <nowiki>Example</nowiki>]<nowiki>
    • The crystals have 150K HP and can be damaged using </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/662249620579155968.png?v=1" alt="dommine" title="dommine" kind="icon" /><nowiki>. The fight ends once all of them are destroyed.
    • After some time, 6 shadow enigmas will spawn and slowly move towards Seiryu. </nowiki>[https://img.pvme.io/images/NqEDUWE.mp4 <nowiki>Example</nowiki>]<nowiki>
        ⬩ Upon reaching his face, enigmas will heal crystals by 50k HP each. </nowiki>[https://img.pvme.io/images/c7V97dw.mp4 <nowiki>Example</nowiki>]<nowiki>
        ⬩ Ignore the first set of enigmas and DPS the crystals.
​
</nowiki></div></div><div><div><u><nowiki>Post-Shackle</nowiki></u><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><div class="pvme-source-preserve-lines"><nowiki>⬥ After the 6th heal is finished, you have 13.2 seconds before you get stunned and teleported back down from the shackle.
    • During this time, a second set of enigmas will have spawned.
        ⬩ Tag and kill them before attacking Seiryu.
    • Seiryu heals back to 7500k HP. Get him down to below 7200k again to continue killing the black crystals.
    • After dragging you down, Seiryu will always start with a Huge Breath attack before continuing his attacking rotation from the previous phase.
        ⬩ </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258240786434.png?v=1" alt="freedom" title="freedom" kind="icon" /><nowiki> or </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306475151390.png?v=1" alt="anti" title="anti" kind="icon" /><nowiki> before getting dragged down, and walk to the south wall while tagging and killing the enigmas to avoid the breath.
        ⬩ Continue attacking Seiryu afterwards.
    • If you kill all 3 crystals during the first shackle segment, the fight ends and this portion will not happen.
​
</nowiki></div></div></div><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><nowiki>

</nowiki></div><nowiki>


</nowiki></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div>
<nowiki>

</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="seiryu-the-azure-serpent-fight-tips"><nowiki>Seiryu, the Azure Serpent (Fight tips)</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Seiryu can be </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/841419289755385866.png?v=1" alt="flankicon" title="flankicon" kind="icon" /><nowiki> permanently when standing along the 2 southern rows of the arena.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Be careful of the V-shaped Shadow Hands if doing this.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ HP can be sustained very easily if </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/615613924506599497.png?v=1" alt="soulsplit" title="soulsplit" kind="icon" /><nowiki> flicking.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• If not, the easiest way to sustain your HP without needing much food is using </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258844635148.png?v=1" alt="res" title="res" kind="icon" /><nowiki> on the huge breath attack.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Move as little you need to avoid the shadow mechanics, to avoid negatively affecting your DPS.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• 1 tile east for blackholes.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• 2-3 tiles to avoid hands from shadow energy.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<pvme-video src="https://img.pvme.io/images/ktXTzON.mp4" controls="1" loop="1" muted="1" type="video/mp4" />
<nowiki>

</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ For learners, you will likely start off with 3-cycling Seiryu, eventually being able to 2-cycle once comfortable with the fight.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Start of fight:</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Use your damage boosting ultimate </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854004678657.png?v=1" alt="zerk" title="zerk" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921595489488927.png?v=1" alt="sunshinepf" title="sunshinepf" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921597813137518.png?v=1" alt="deathsswiftpf" title="deathsswiftpf" kind="icon" /><nowiki> to start the fight.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Use abilities until Seiryu phases. Do not use your ultimate again.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• When Seiryu is at around 7250k, build to 100% adrenaline and prepare to jump.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• When Seiryu lowers his head, quickly go to either jump tile and go up ASAP. </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/867678153668820992.png?v=1" alt="bdmobile" title="bdmobile" kind="icon" /><nowiki> there if you can.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Shackle:</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/867678153798975498.png?v=1" alt="surgemobile" title="surgemobile" kind="icon" /><nowiki> towards the first crystal and use your damage boosting ultimate </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854004678657.png?v=1" alt="zerk" title="zerk" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921595489488927.png?v=1" alt="sunshinepf" title="sunshinepf" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921597813137518.png?v=1" alt="deathsswiftpf" title="deathsswiftpf" kind="icon" /><nowiki> with </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/736298121704767538.png?v=1" alt="adrenrenewal" title="adrenrenewal" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and deploy </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/662249620579155968.png?v=1" alt="dommine" title="dommine" kind="icon" /><nowiki> immediately.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Kill the first crystal and build until the first waves of heals are complete, then get in as much damage on the second crystal as possible until you get dragged down.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Use </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/662249620579155968.png?v=1" alt="dommine" title="dommine" kind="icon" /><nowiki> immediately once they're off cooldown.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Post-shackle:</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Immediately tag and kill enigmas when you are on the ground.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Use your damage boosting ultimate </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854004678657.png?v=1" alt="zerk" title="zerk" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921595489488927.png?v=1" alt="sunshinepf" title="sunshinepf" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921597813137518.png?v=1" alt="deathsswiftpf" title="deathsswiftpf" kind="icon" /><nowiki> again on Seiryu and repeat what you did at the start.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Second shackle:</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• If you had a lot of time left after killing the first crystal during the first shackle, go for a 2-cycle.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Jump up from a different side to attack the crystal at full HP.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Use your </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854004678657.png?v=1" alt="zerk" title="zerk" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921595489488927.png?v=1" alt="sunshinepf" title="sunshinepf" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921597813137518.png?v=1" alt="deathsswiftpf" title="deathsswiftpf" kind="icon" /><nowiki> with </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/736298121704767538.png?v=1" alt="adrenrenewal" title="adrenrenewal" kind="icon" /><nowiki> with </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/662249620579155968.png?v=1" alt="dommine" title="dommine" kind="icon" /><nowiki> immediately after going up and then finish off the middle crystal with your strongest abilities afterwards.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• If the remaining crystal has too much health for you to finish off before the heals start, do a 3rd cycle.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="mobs-and-movement"><nowiki>Mobs and movement</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>Although mobs in ED1 do not have much HP, many of them have mechanics with very high KO potential. Do not be surprised if you die to any of these.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Death Lotus Assassins</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• These are by far the most dangerous mobs and are found in 2 areas, after Sanctum Guardian and before Masuta. You do not need to kill them to proceed.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• At the part after Sanctum, use </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158728953857.png?v=1" alt="devo" title="devo" kind="icon" /><nowiki> with </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/544195488317046812.png?v=1" alt="DeflectRange" title="DeflectRange" kind="icon" /><nowiki> after 'You are no more!' while clearing the 3 Zealots to avoid dying.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<pvme-video src="https://img.pvme.io/images/rwE2Ei3.mp4" controls="1" loop="1" muted="1" type="video/mp4" />
<nowiki>

</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• 2 more are found near the barrier before Masuta. You may aggro them while running to the 4 Zealots you need to clear to open the barrier.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Pray </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/544195488317046812.png?v=1" alt="DeflectRange" title="DeflectRange" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and food in mouth if needed. Teleport out </nowiki><strong><nowiki>after opening the gate</nowiki></strong><nowiki> if needing to bank.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Don't use </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158728953857.png?v=1" alt="devo" title="devo" kind="icon" /><nowiki> here if going into Masuta directly as you will need </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158728953857.png?v=1" alt="devo" title="devo" kind="icon" /><nowiki> for Masuta's hurricane.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><pvme-image src="https://img.pvme.io/images/IwHIix8.png" alt="" title="" kind="media" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Always use </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/544195488317046812.png?v=1" alt="DeflectRange" title="DeflectRange" kind="icon" /><nowiki> when you see them attacking no matter what as they can hit you from a decent distance.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<pvme-video src="https://img.pvme.io/images/WoaCM1c.mp4" controls="1" loop="1" muted="1" type="video/mp4" />
<nowiki>

</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Hanto Sellswords</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• These can be found right after Sanctum Guardian and near the Menaphite Soldiers before Masuta.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• It is not necessary to kill them to proceed.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Beware of their 'Die by the blade!' attack where they spin their spear, dealing very heavy melee damage which can 2-3 hit you if not careful.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Quickly use </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/544195488447201300.png?v=1" alt="DeflectMelee" title="DeflectMelee" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and eat or </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/841419289428492369.png?v=1" alt="stunicon" title="stunicon" kind="icon" /><nowiki> them to stop it.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Defence pylons</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• They attacking using rapid moderate </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1" alt="Magic" title="Magic" kind="icon" /><nowiki> beams and are quite long-ranged.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• You need to kill 3 of these to access Seiryu.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• It is recommended to go into the Seiryu encounter after Masuta straight as using the bank chest near Seiryu is not practical due to getting harassed by these crystals.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ You can always teleport out </nowiki><strong><nowiki>after opening the gate to Seiryu</nowiki></strong><nowiki> if needed to stop their aggro.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Pray </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/544195487926845462.png?v=1" alt="DeflectMage" title="DeflectMage" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and use </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158728953857.png?v=1" alt="devo" title="devo" kind="icon" /><nowiki> right before engaging the first Pylon. Kill it fast to extend </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158728953857.png?v=1" alt="devo" title="devo" kind="icon" /><nowiki> before killing 2 more.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Try to end on high adrenaline and proceed to Seiryu</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<pvme-video src="https://img.pvme.io/images/9JmjLtG.mp4" controls="1" loop="1" muted="1" type="video/mp4" />
<nowiki>

</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Other noteworthy mobs</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Elite Sakadagami: Uses highly damaging </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1" alt="Magic" title="Magic" kind="icon" /><nowiki> abilities which can also stun you. Use </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/544195487926845462.png?v=1" alt="DeflectMage" title="DeflectMage" kind="icon" /><nowiki> especially if facing multiple of them.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Elite Sotapanna: Occasionally heals damaged mobs to full using a healing orb.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Arhats and Anagami: Can follow you into the Sanctum Guardian fight, making it much harder. Teleport out to get rid of them if needed.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ AoEs by style, generally from most to least viable</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Melee: </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532878969438210.png?v=1" alt="cane" title="cane" kind="icon" /><nowiki> &gt; </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879506309150.png?v=1" alt="quake" title="quake" kind="icon" /><nowiki> &gt; </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/864492981763702834.png?v=1" alt="flurry" title="flurry" kind="icon" /><nowiki> &gt; </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532878616985610.png?v=1" alt="cleave" title="cleave" kind="icon" /><nowiki> &gt; targeted </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854281764884.png?v=1" alt="bd" title="bd" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879359377439.png?v=1" alt="meteorstrike" title="meteorstrike" kind="icon" /><nowiki> is extremely good at places with lots of enemies.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Ranged: </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641669268722810881.png?v=1" alt="mechchin" title="mechchin" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541270521708566.png?v=1" alt="rapid" title="rapid" kind="icon" /><nowiki> &gt; </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641669268722810881.png?v=1" alt="mechchin" title="mechchin" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535534127131394088.png?v=1" alt="snap" title="snap" kind="icon" /><nowiki> &gt; </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306391265284.png?v=1" alt="bombard" title="bombard" kind="icon" /><nowiki> &gt; </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306294796299.png?v=1" alt="corruptshot" title="corruptshot" kind="icon" /><nowiki> &gt; </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641669268722810881.png?v=1" alt="mechchin" title="mechchin" kind="icon" /><nowiki> basic &gt; </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/867678153635004447.png?v=1" alt="ricocaroming" title="ricocaroming" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641669268722810881.png?v=1" alt="mechchin" title="mechchin" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/959089455283728386.png?v=1" alt="deadshotigneous" title="deadshotigneous" kind="icon" /><nowiki> is good way to clear hordes of enemies fast to avoid getting overwhelmed.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Magic: </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/958989794757730307.png?v=1" alt="tsunamiincite" title="tsunamiincite" kind="icon" /><nowiki> &gt; </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833358016512.png?v=1" alt="deto" title="deto" kind="icon" /><nowiki> &gt; </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190159194259467.png?v=1" alt="corruptblast" title="corruptblast" kind="icon" /><nowiki> &gt; </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833391702017.png?v=1" alt="dbreath" title="dbreath" kind="icon" /><nowiki> &gt; </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/867678153962684426.png?v=1" alt="chaincaroming" title="chaincaroming" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ 4TAA using </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537338981747261446.png?v=1" alt="bloodbarrage" title="bloodbarrage" kind="icon" /><nowiki> or </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400185245701.png?v=1" alt="icebarrage" title="icebarrage" kind="icon" /><nowiki> is very helpful for clears.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/867678153882861568.png?v=1" alt="gchaincaroming" title="gchaincaroming" kind="icon" /><nowiki> should be used whenever possible if owned for clears, especially with </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1179505745654448208.png?v=1" alt="omnipowerigneous" title="omnipowerigneous" kind="icon" /></p>
